label: ACCEPT
reason: Every other component under editor/ is written as export const X = memo(function X(...)) (CodeSidebar.tsx, EmptyState.tsx, PreviewContainer.tsx), and no lint rule in eslint.config.js enforces it. InlineChatWidget and ViewContentArea are ordinary function components that could be memoized just as easily, so this is a team choice worth a second look in review. I hesitated with WRONG incidental, because memo matters less for the keyed portal widget.

label: WRONG
reason: The tool follows in-repo inheritance (UserOut(UserBase) and QueuedMessage(QueuedMessageBase) count as members). The only two outliers in auth.py extend fastapi_users schemas.BaseUser / BaseUserCreate, which are themselves pydantic BaseModel subclasses that fastapi-users requires, so neither really breaks the rule. I hesitated with ACCEPT, since with no counted outliers a plain non-pydantic class in schemas/ would be worth flagging.

label: ACCEPT
reason: Handlers take Depends(get_current_user) (ai_model.py, inbox.py, push.py). The 7 chat.py outliers authenticate through ensure_chat_access / ensure_member_chat_access, which depend on get_current_user in deps.py chat_access_dependency (not_violation, 7 of 16). The other outliers are reachable endpoints with no get_current_user: public auth flows in auth.py, instance.py get_instance, and the main.py health/readyz probes, plus get_me on current_active_user. Under R3 these are exceptions a reviewer would want to confirm, so 9 of 9 counted outliers are look.
